source_refs.note: Book p. 220-221: 12.1.6 Theorem 1 (a)-(g) with examples, closing sentence on substitution. Book errors: (a) example 'Lim x->a 5' (should be x->1); (e) example has stray f and g in Lim f(3x+4) / Lim g(x+3). Teaching notes and our examples are ours.

items.title: 12.1.6 Theorems on Limits of Functions (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein kitab ne kaha tha ke table se limit nikalna na munasib hai na mumkin; humein seedhe qaide chahiye. Aaj woh qaide aa gaye: limits ke theorems. In ke saath aap bari bari limits do teen lines mein nikal lenge. Har theorem ke saath hum dekhenge ke woh sach kyun hai aur kab lagta hai.
Kitab kehti hai: farz karein \(f\) aur \(g\) do functions hain jin ke liye \(\lim_{x \to a} f(x) = L\) aur \(\lim_{x \to a} g(x) = M\), to
Theorem 1
(a) Do functions ke jama (sum) ki limit un ki limits ke jama ke barabar hai.
bold: (a) Do functions ke jama (sum) ki limit un ki limits ke jama ke barabar hai.

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x \to a}[f(x) + g(x)] \\ &= \lim_{x \to a} f(x) + \lim_{x \to a} g(x) \\ &= L + M\end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: limit as x approaches a of f of x plus g of x equals limit of f of x plus limit of g of x, which is L plus M

blocks.text:
Misal ke taur par,
\[\lim_{x \to 1}(x + 5)\]
\[= \lim_{x \to 1} x + \lim_{x \to 1} 5\]
\[= 1 + 5 = 6\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab doosre qadam mein \(\lim_{x \to a} 5\) chhaapti hai, yani limit ke neeche \(x \to a\). Is misaal mein teeno limits \(x \to 1\) wali hain. Sahi: \(\lim_{x \to 1} x + \lim_{x \to 1} 5 = 1 + 5 = 6\). Hum ne upar sahi likha hai.
(b) Do functions ke farq (difference) ki limit un ki limits ke farq ke barabar hai.
bold: (b) Do functions ke farq (difference) ki limit un ki limits ke farq ke barabar hai.

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x \to a}[f(x) - g(x)] \\ &= \lim_{x \to a} f(x) - \lim_{x \to a} g(x) \\ &= L - M\end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: limit as x approaches a of f of x minus g of x equals limit of f of x minus limit of g of x, which is L minus M

blocks.text:
Misal ke taur par,
\[\lim_{x \to 3}(x - 5)\]
\[= \lim_{x \to 3} x - \lim_{x \to 3} 5\]
\[= 3 - 5 = -2\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
(a) aur (b) sach kyun hain? Agar \(f(x)\), \(L\) ke bohat qareeb hai aur \(g(x)\), \(M\) ke bohat qareeb, to un ka jama \(L + M\) ke bohat qareeb hoga aur farq \(L - M\) ke. Chhoti chhoti ghaltiyan jama karein to bhi chhoti hi rehti hain.
Rozmarra ki misaal: aap ki jeb mein taqreeban 100 rupay hain aur dost ki jeb mein taqreeban 50. Dono ke paas mil kar taqreeban 150 honge. Jitna andaaza pakka, utna jawab pakka.
Do aasaan limits baar baar kaam aati hain: \(\lim_{x \to a} x = a\) (jab \(x\), \(a\) ki taraf jaye to \(x\) khud \(a\) ki taraf jata hai) aur \(\lim_{x \to a} c = c\) (constant kabhi nahin badalta). Yeh (g) mein hain.
(c) Agar \(k\) koi bhi real number ho, to
bold: koi bhi real number ho, to

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x \to a}[k f(x)] \\ &= k \lim_{x \to a} f(x) = kL\end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: limit as x approaches a of k times f of x equals k times the limit of f of x, which is k L

blocks.text:
Misal ke taur par,
\[\lim_{x \to 2}(3x) = 3\lim_{x \to 2}(x)\]
\[= 3(2) = 6\]

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Theorem (c) kehta hai ke constant (jaise 3) ko limit ke bahar nikaal sakte hain. Kyun? Agar \(f(x)\) taqreeban \(L\) hai to \(3f(x)\) taqreeban \(3L\) hoga. Constant khud nahin badalta, sirf saath chalta hai.
(d) Functions ke hasil-e-zarb (product) ki limit un ki limits ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar hai.
bold: (d) Functions ke hasil-e-zarb (product) ki limit un ki limits ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar hai.

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x \to a}[f(x)\, g(x)] \\ &= \lim_{x \to a} f(x) \cdot \lim_{x \to a} g(x) \\ &= LM\end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: limit as x approaches a of f of x times g of x equals limit of f of x times limit of g of x, which is L M

blocks.text:
Misal ke taur par,
\[\lim_{x \to 1}(2x)(x + 4)\]
\[= \lim_{x \to 1}(2x) \cdot \lim_{x \to 1}(x + 4)\]
\[= (2)(5) = 10\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Misal (d) ko qadam ba qadam dekhiye. Pehle dono factors ko alag kiya: \(2x\) aur \(x + 4\). Phir har ek ki limit \(x \to 1\) par nikaali: \(2(1) = 2\) aur \(1 + 4 = 5\). Aakhir mein dono ko zarb diya: \(2 \times 5 = 10\).
Kyun sahi hai: agar ek cheez taqreeban 2 hai aur doosri taqreeban 5, to un ka hasil-e-zarb taqreeban 10 hi hoga. Jaise kisi kamre ki lambai taqreeban 5 meter aur chaurai taqreeban 2 meter ho to area taqreeban 10 square meter hota hai.
(e) Functions ke quotient (taqseem) ki limit un ki limits ke quotient ke barabar hai, ba-shart ke denominator ki limit zero na ho.
bold: (e) Functions ke quotient (taqseem) ki limit un ki limits ke quotient ke barabar hai, ba-shart ke denominator ki limit zero na ho.

blocks.text_alt: limit as x approaches a of f of x over g of x equals limit of f of x over limit of g of x, which is L over M

blocks.text: ba-shart ke \(a\) ke ird gird (neighbourhood mein) \(g(x) \ne 0\) ho aur \(M \ne 0\) ho.

Misal:
\[\lim_{x \to 2}\left[\dfrac{3x + 4}{x + 3}\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{\lim_{x \to 2} (3x + 4)}{\lim_{x \to 2} (x + 3)}\]
\[= \dfrac{6 + 4}{2 + 3} = \dfrac{10}{5} = 2\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab beech wale qadam mein \(\frac{\lim f(3x + 4)}{\lim g(x + 3)}\) chhaapti hai, yani \(f\) aur \(g\) faltu likhe hain. Yahan \(f(x) = 3x + 4\) aur \(g(x) = x + 3\) khud hain, is liye sahi qadam \(\dfrac{\lim_{x \to 2}(3x + 4)}{\lim_{x \to 2}(x + 3)}\) hai. Hum ne upar sahi likha hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
(e) mein \(M \ne 0\) kyun zaroori hai? Zero se divide karne ka koi matlab nahin. Agar denominator ki limit \(0\) ho to theorem (e) nahin lag sakta; pehle expression ko simplify karna hoga.
Misal: \(\lim_{x \to 2} \frac{x^{2} - 4}{x - 2}\). Denominator \(0\) ki taraf ja raha hai, to (e) fail. Factorise kijiye aur cancel kijiye (jaayez hai, kyun ke \(x \ne 2\)): \(\frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{x - 2} = x + 2\). Ab limit \(2 + 2 = 4\).
Kyun: limit mein \(x\) kabhi \(2\) nahin banta, is liye \(x - 2\) kabhi zero nahin; zero na ho to cancel karna bilkul sahi hai. Section 12.2 poora isi qism ke sawalon ke baare mein hai.
(f) \([f(x)]^{n}\) ki limit, jahan \(n\) integer hai

blocks.text_alt: limit as x approaches a of f of x to the power n equals the limit of f of x, to the power n, which is L to the power n

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Theorem (f) asal mein (d) ko baar baar lagana hai: \([f(x)]^{3} = f(x) \cdot f(x) \cdot f(x)\), to limit \(L \cdot L \cdot L = L^{3}\). Agar \(n\) negative integer ho to \(L \ne 0\) bhi chahiye, kyun ke \(L^{-2} = \frac{1}{L^{2}}\) mein \(L\) denominator mein chala jata hai, aur zero se divide nahin ho sakta.
(1) \(\lim_{x \to a} x^{p} = a^{p}\), jahan \(p > 0\) aur \(p \in \mathbb{R}\)
(2) \(\lim_{x \to a} c = c\)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: (g)(1) mein agar \(p\) poora number na ho to \(a^{p}\) ka real number hona zaroori hai. Misal: \(\lim_{x \to 9} x^{1/2} = 9^{1/2} = 3\) theek hai, kyun ke \(x^{1/2} = \sqrt{x}\) aur \(\sqrt{9} = 3\). Lekin \(a = -4\) ke qareeb \(\sqrt{x}\) real hi nahin, to wahan yeh qaida nahin lagta. (g)(2) mein \(c\) constant hai: \(\lim_{x \to 5} 7 = 7\), kyun ke \(7\) ki value \(x\) par munhasir nahin; \(x\) kuch bhi kare, 7 saat hi rehta hai.

Kitab aakhir mein kehti hai: limits ke theorems se hum is nateeje par pohanchte hain ke limits sirf us number ko function mein rakh (substitute kar) kar nikal aati hain jis ki taraf \(x\) ja raha hai.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Yeh "sirf rakh do" wala qaida un functions ke liye hai jin par upar ke theorems lag sakein, jaise polynomials, aur woh fractions jin ke denominator ki limit zero na ho. Jahan rakhne se \(\frac{0}{0}\) aaye, wahan rukiye aur pehle simplify kijiye.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
\(\lim_{x \to 2}(x^{2} + 3x - 1)\) nikaliye.
\[\lim_{x \to 2}(x^{2} + 3x - 1)\]
\[= \lim_{x \to 2} x^{2} + \lim_{x \to 2} 3x - \lim_{x \to 2} 1\]
\[= (2)^{2} + 3(2) - 1\]
\[= 4 + 6 - 1 = 9\]
Kyun: (a) aur (b) ne jama aur farq ko alag alag limits mein tod diya; (c) ne 3 ko bahar nikala; (f) ya (g)(1) se \(\lim x^{2} = 4\); (g)(2) se \(\lim 1 = 1\).
Ek aur: \(\lim_{x \to 4}\frac{2x + 1}{x - 3}\). Pehle denominator check kijiye: us ki limit \(4 - 3 = 1 \ne 0\), to (e) lag sakta hai:
\[\lim_{x \to 4} \dfrac{2x + 1}{x - 3}\]
\[= \dfrac{\lim_{x \to 4}(2x + 1)}{\lim_{x \to 4}(x - 3)}\]
\[= \dfrac{8 + 1}{4 - 3} = \dfrac{9}{1} = 9\]
Tasdeeq: seedha \(x = 4\) rakhne se bhi \(\frac{9}{1} = 9\) aata hai, bilkul jaisa kitab ka aakhri jumla kehta hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(\lim_{x \to 3}(x^{2} - 2x)^{2}\) nikaliye. Kaun kaun se theorems lagenge?
Jawab: (f) se \(\left(\lim_{x \to 3}(x^{2} - 2x)\right)^{2}\); phir (b), (g) se andar \(9 - 6 = 3\); to jawab \(3^{2} = 9\).

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Exam mein theorem istemal karein to qadam ke saath bracket mein us ka naam likh dein, jaise "(limit of a sum)" ya "(limit of a quotient, denominator ki limit \(\ne 0\))". Quotient wala theorem lagane se pehle hamesha denominator ki limit check kijiye. Is se examiner ko pata chalta hai ke aap samajh kar likh rahe hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Limits jama, farq, constant multiple aur product par toot jaati hain: \(L + M\), \(L - M\), \(kL\), \(LM\).
2. Quotient ki limit \(= \frac{L}{M}\) sirf tab jab \(M \ne 0\).
3. \(\lim [f(x)]^{n} = L^{n}\); \(\lim x^{p} = a^{p}\); \(\lim c = c\).
4. Is liye polynomials (aur woh quotients jin ka denominator zero ki taraf na jaye) mein limit \(x = a\) rakh kar nikal aati hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Denominator zero ho jaye phir bhi aankh band kar ke substitute kar dena. \(\frac{0}{0}\) na \(1\) hai na \(0\); is ka matlab hai "pehle simplify karo".
2. Hisaab ke beech mein point badal dena (jaise kitab ki misaal (a) mein \(x \to a\) chhap gaya). Ek hi hal mein har limit ke neeche wahi \(x \to a\) hona chahiye.
3. Value rakhne ke baad bhi "lim" likhte rehna, jaise aakhir mein "\(\lim 5\)". Jab \(x\) ki jagah number aa gaya to limit ka nishan hata dein.
